goal: Prevent banlist and settings files from being corrupted or truncated if a crash occurs during a write
Ensure settings and ban updates are replaced atomically rather than written directly in place
agreement: Strong support with all earlier concerns on API safety, temp files, and tests resolved
Tested on FreeBSD and approved the self-contained atomic write implementation (winterrdog)
Approved noting that the new test coverage is useful (Herb-ops)

categories.name: utils
why: P3 because atomic updates prevent corrupted or empty banlist files following unexpected shutdowns
The benefit is limited to protecting local state during rare crash or write-interruption scenarios
